nodes.label: Backlog Workflow Policy
nodes.rationale: Authoritative repository policy: Backlog MCP is the transport for task, milestone, document, and DoD operations; its workflow resources are not repository policy.

nodes.label: Backlog Task Creation
nodes.rationale: Search before creating; one task per focused deliverable; descriptions and acceptance criteria are durable work orders stating outcomes and constraints, not speculative implementations.

nodes.label: Backlog Task Execution
nodes.rationale: Read the full task, confirm dependencies and scope, mark In Progress, research, and keep plan and notes current; discovered out-of-scope work must be escalated, not silently absorbed.

nodes.label: Backlog Task Finalization
nodes.rationale: Verify each acceptance criterion with objective evidence, record a final summary, mark Done, and leave completed tasks in Done until periodic cleanup.

nodes.label: Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: Project DoD defaults apply to new tasks; documentation-only changes are exempt from unit and e2e tests unless explicitly requested.
